body.name: Shared-law pairwise differences and regret correspondence
body.construction: \(D_{mj}=\sup_{v\in\mathcal V(p_{BT},q)}(v_m-v_j)\in\mathbb R\), \(R_m=\max_{j\in\mathcal M}D_{mj}\ge0\), and \(\mathcal M^\star=\operatorname*{argmin}_{m\in\mathcal M}R_m\). The inequality for \(R_m\) follows from the included comparator \(j=m\), for which \(D_{mm}=0\); no sign restriction is imposed on \(D_{mj}\) when \(m\ne j\).
